title: Sharp instability of planar isotropic--nematic interfaces in the Landau--de Gennes model
summary: We study the stability of one-dimensional planar isotropic--nematic interfaces in the Landau--de Gennes model with anisotropic elastic constant $L$. Earlier work proved the instability for $L<0$ only under an extra condition. We remove this condition and prove that any non-negative minimizer of the reduced energy within the diagonal planar class is unstable under general one-dimensional perturbations throughout $-\frac{3}{2}<L<0$.
